procedure_a_prescribed_displacement_repl.name: Procedure A: Prescribed-State Stress Replay (Non-Equilibrated)
procedure_a_prescribed_displacement_repl.definition: Nodal displacements u_donor(x, y) from Job 1421063.mmaster02 are prescribed as Dirichlet conditions on all nodes of the receiver mesh. Strains are evaluated via epsilon = B * u, and stresses via sigma = g(d) * C_0 : epsilon. The solver does NOT iterate to static equilibrium; displacements are kinematically fixed. Reaction forces at nodes reflect R = F_int - F_ext, which will have nonzero residuals wherever the recovery mesh discretization or quadrature differs from the donor UEL.
procedure_a_prescribed_displacement_repl.use_case: Pure kinematic verification of constitutive evaluation

procedure_b_auxiliary_equilibrium_recove.name: Procedure B: Auxiliary Equilibrium Recovery (Forward Solve)
procedure_b_auxiliary_equilibrium_recove.definition: Only macroscopic boundary displacement (u_y = 0.00959078 mm) is applied to the top edge, with roller support on bottom edge and pinned origin. Internal nodes are free. The degraded modulus field E(x) = g(d(x)) * E_0 is mapped to standard continuum elements (via USDFLD). Abaqus/Standard solves the boundary value problem to exact static equilibrium (F_ext = F_int) using Newton-Raphson. Internal displacements self-equilibrate smoothly.
procedure_b_auxiliary_equilibrium_recove.use_case: Self-consistent continuum stress field suitable for Zienkiewicz-Zhu Superconvergent Patch Recovery (MISESERI)

severe_crack_core_d_ge_0p80.physical_interpretation: Broken crack band has degraded modulus (g(d) ~ 1e-5), so physical stresses are relieved to near zero. Minor residual stress differences produce lower Pearson r but negligible influence on global equilibrium.

miseseri_field_audit.raw_miseseri_units: MPa (von Mises equivalent of stress discretization error tensor)

raw_miseseri_statistics_MPa.max_location: Notch tip and active crack propagation fronts

miseseri_field_audit.errorTarget_sensitivity_explanation: Under errorTarget = 0.02 (2.0%), because 59.3% of undamaged far-field elements exceed 2%, Abaqus UNIFORM_ERROR remeshing algorithm forces widespread far-field refinement, producing 77,211 elements. Under errorTarget = 0.05 (5.0%), the far-field is largely compliant (only 16.8% marked), while the active softening zone (98.4% marked) and crack core (100% marked) strongly demand maximum refinement, resulting in a compact, highly selective 20,213-element mesh (F1664).

synthesis.justification: PK_HOLE_F1659_RECOVERY.odb supplies a self-equilibrated continuum stress field with Pearson r = 0.9575 and NRMSE = 4.05% relative to the authentic coarse coupled UEL simulation (Job 1421063.mmaster02). It generates authentic, nonzero Abaqus MISESERI (median 2.87 MPa, peak 1437.36 MPa) natively across all 2,935 elements. It preserves CAD geometry boundaries and 100% disconnected crack flanks. Attempting Procedure A (prescribed-displacement replay) would introduce non-equilibrated nodal force residuals without improving the Superconvergent Patch Recovery polynomial smoothing.
